title: Complex Analysis: An Introduction to the Theory of Analytic Functions of One Complex Variable
note: Standard source for Cauchy's theorem on a rectangle/polygon (Ch. 4 §1) and the residue theorem (Ch. 4 §5). Cited by `QOU/Mathlib/ParallelogramContour.lean` for its ONE remaining Mathlib-gap axiom, `parallelogramIntegral_inv_sub_eq_two_pi_i` (the value 2πi for a simple interior pole). The Cauchy-vanishing companion was an axiom when this entry was written and is now PROVED in-repo, on `main`, so §1 is cited as context rather than as a carried assumption. UNVERIFIED: ISBN — no publisher record was reachable, so it is omitted rather than guessed.
